arms: those of search-v0.1, unchanged (the menu; the local model sampled four times plus the menu)

budget.note: both searches are breadth-first and stop only on a proof, an empty frontier, or the budget, so the first b expansions of a run at 192 are a run at budget b

checks.C1: for every task, the menu arm's first 24 expansions of each search equal those committed by search-v0.1 (expansion records and proof), since the menu proposer is deterministic

developmentChecksBeforeRegistration: the runner was exercised on one task at budget 4; no unit of this corpus was run at a larger budget
execution: every (task, arm, search) unit in a fresh REPL; four units at a time; the model server with four parallel slots

hypotheses.H17: in both arms the goal-duplicate fraction within 192 expansions is at least 2 times the fraction within 24 (on the same runs)
hypotheses.H18: within 192 expansions the AND-OR search proves at least as many tasks as the whole-state search in both arms, and strictly more in at least one
hypotheses.H19: in both arms the order-duplicate fraction within 192 expansions is below 5%

measures: as in search-v0.1, at each checkpoint: order- and goal-duplicate fractions over the whole-state expansions within the checkpoint, and tasks proved within it by each search
question: do the redundancies measured by search-v0.1, and the comparison of whole-state and AND-OR search, change when the searches run eight times deeper
searches: those of search-v0.1 after its amendment 2, unchanged

tasks.rule: the search-v0.1 tasks on which at least one of the four searches used all 24 expansions without a proof, in search-v0.1 order
